answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 15 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The summit debit happens at intake, velvet totals the burned amount, and prism anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm therefore pays the burn once for each extra identity on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. That is 33 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
